Section10.Title: Frequently Asked Questions
Section10.Subtitle: Quick answers to help you shop with confidence.

Faqs.Question: What should I buy before studying abroad?
Faqs.Answer: Focus on university-specified stationery, universal destination power adapters, a reliable laptop sleeve, waterproof document portfolios for visa/passport files, and compact study room essentials.

Faqs.Question: Can I customize my study kit?
Faqs.Answer: Yes! Use our 'Build Your Own Study Kit' interactive builder in Section 6 to choose the exact components you need with live price calculation.

Faqs.Question: Can I purchase products individually?
Faqs.Answer: Yes, all products featured in our kits and setups can be ordered individually directly from our Study Essentials catalog.

Faqs.Question: Do you deliver internationally?
Faqs.Answer: Yes, Dreamflykit delivers to dorms, apartments, and student residences across the USA, UK, Canada, Australia, Europe, and India.

Faqs.Question: What are the return and refund policies?
Faqs.Answer: We offer a 30-day student satisfaction guarantee with no-hassle replacements or full refunds on any transit-damaged or unsuitable items.

GuidePages.Title: Stay Study-Ready
GuidePages.Subtitle: Prepare for your academic journey abroad.
GuidePages.Description: Get the right study materials, stay organized, and build good study habits for a successful university experience.
GuidePages.Section1Title: What Do You Need for Your Studies?
GuidePages.Section1Subtitle: Before you head abroad, make sure you have the right study essentials and check your university's guidelines for specific requirements.
PrepGuideItems: Check if your university recommends specific books or materials
Carry essential notebooks and writing supplies
Keep an academic planner to manage assignments and deadlines
Organize your certificates and study documents
Check if your course requires a calculator or other tools
GuidePages.ProTipContent: Always check your university's website for a detailed list of recommended materials for your course.
GuidePages.MistakesSectionSubtitle: Tips to help international students succeed.

Mistakes.Title: Overpacking
Mistakes.Description: Only carry what you really need

Mistakes.Title: Ignoring climate needs
Mistakes.Description: Pack suitable clothing for your destination

Mistakes.Title: Not checking power compatibility
Mistakes.Description: Use the right adapters and converters

GuidePages.BottomBannerSubtitle: Customize your perfect study kit with essentials for your course and destination.

GuidePages.Title: Stay Connected
GuidePages.Subtitle: Get your digital essentials ready before departure.
GuidePages.Description: Stay connected, stay productive and make the most of your online classes, research and campus life.
GuidePages.Section1Subtitle: From online classes to research and assignments, the right tech makes it easier to stay productive and connected.
PrepGuideItems: Check if your laptop meets your course requirements
Verify charger and voltage compatibility with your destination
Choose a mouse and headphones for comfortable study
Check if you need a USB hub or external storage
Get a travel adapter for your destination's plug type
GuidePages.ProTipContent: Check your destination's plug type and voltage (e.g. 110V/220V) before buying electronics.
GuidePages.MistakesSectionSubtitle: Tips to help international students succeed.
GuidePages.BottomBannerSubtitle: Use our tech guide to find the right devices for your study needs.

GuidePages.Title: Keep Documents Organized
GuidePages.Subtitle: Keep your important documents safe and accessible.
GuidePages.Description: From passports to admission letters, make sure you have everything ready for a smooth journey.
GuidePages.Section1Subtitle: Each country and university may have different requirements. Check the official guidelines and plan accordingly.
PrepGuideItems: Keep your passport and visa documents accessible
Carry your university admission letter
Organize academic certificates and transcripts
Keep accommodation and travel details available
Store secure digital copies of important documents
Check official instructions for your destination
GuidePages.ProTipContent: Keep both physical and digital copies of your important documents in a safe place.
GuidePages.MistakesSectionSubtitle: Tips to help international students succeed.
GuidePages.BottomBannerSubtitle: Organized documents = less stress and more time for what matters.

GuidePages.Section1Title: What Will Make Your Daily Life Easier?

PrepGuideItems: Check what your accommodation already provides
Choose a comfortable backpack for your campus
